show.description: Arjun, an honest officer, meets Shruthi, an heiress disguised as an employee. Their past admiration reignites amid workplace clashes and Raghav’s schemes. A clerical error marries them, sparking chaos. Defying her father, Shruthi exposes corruption and stands by Arjun. From humiliation to honor, destiny unites their love and redemption.
